hero.title: Queens Restaurant: Authentic Punjabi Flavors, Decades of Delight!
hero.subtitle: Experience the essence of Punjab, where every dish is a blend of authentic flavors and exquisite ingredients, delighting your palate and nourishing your spirit with every savory bite.

about.title: Our Culinary Legacy & Warm Punjabi Heart
about.paragraph1: Established in 1974, Queens Restaurant has been delighting patrons with authentic Punjabi cuisine for nearly five decades. Our culinary journey is a tribute to time-honored recipes, where every dish is crafted with love, expertise, and a blend of exquisite, fresh ingredients. Experience the true essence of Punjab, straight from our kitchen to your hearts.
about.paragraph2: We pride ourselves on using locally sourced, aromatic spices, tender meats, and seasonal vegetables to create unforgettable flavors. Beyond the vibrant tastes, we offer a warm, welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere where our attentive staff ensures every guest feels like royalty, making each visit a memorable dining experience.
